string.text: Star Iron
Preliminary Covenant Blade
Journeyman's Smithing Seal
Heart's Fire Crucible
Legendary Covenant Sword
Requires 10,000 Gold
Requires 2,000 Gold
Requires 2,000 Gold
Requires Roguery 50
Requires Roguery 80
Requires 50,000 Gold
Must be a sworn Vassal of a Realm
Apprentice's Oath

Your clan's deeds echo across the taverns and keeps of Calradia. The renowned master smith {EfsaneviDemirci_Link}, located in {DemirciSehri_Link}, has sent word, seeking you out to reforge an ancient blade bound to your bloodline.

Ride to the village of {HammadeKaynagi_Link} and speak with {KoyMuhtari_Link} to procure 5 Star Iron ore. Beware: rumors suggest cutthroats hired by {RakipTuccar_Link} are already circling the quarry.
Hired Assassins
That star iron belongs to our master! Turn back, lordling, or your blood will quench the ore!
My steel will speak for me. Draw!
The rival merchant's hired mercenaries are nearby carrying the stolen Star Iron! Defeat them in battle to reclaim the ore.
You crushed the hired ambushers and pried 5 Star Iron ore from their baggage! Return to {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} to forge the blade.
You bypassed the ore gathering by purchasing the master's ready-forged sword for a steep sum of 10,000 denars.
You delivered the 5 Star Iron ore to {EfsaneviDemirci_Link}. With ancient craft and roaring coals, the master forged your bloodline's Covenant Sword!
You hold 5 Star Iron in your packs. Deliver them to {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} so the forging of the Covenant Sword can begin.
You sent word for me, master smith?

Aye, warlord. Your name echoes across every feast hall. I knew your forebears well; I helped forge the ancestral steel that carved your house's seat. It is time you carried a true weapon of your lineage. Yet ordinary iron cannot bear such an oath; I require 5 chunks of genuine Star Iron.
Where can I unearth such a rare ore?

A celestial deposit was uncovered in the deep quarry near {HammadeKaynagi_Link}. Ride to the village and speak with the elder {KoyMuhtari_Link}. But keep your hand on your hilt, for a jealous merchant named {RakipTuccar_Link} has placed spies around my workshop and covets the vein.
Master, don't misunderstand... War waits for no smith. Is that finished blade upon your rack for sale? Can I purchase it here and now for 10,000 gold?

You lack the patience of a true swordsman, child. Yet if coin is how you wage war, so be it. Take the blade; it carries the blood of my forge, even if bought rather than earned. We shall see if you are worthy of what comes next...
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
I am here on behalf of {EfsaneviDemirci_Link}. I have come to collect the Star Iron ore from your quarry.

Gods deliver us! You arrive in the shadow of disaster, warrior! We mined five hefty chunks of Star Iron, but just an hour ago, bloodthirsty sellswords bearing the mark of {RakipTuccar_Link} raided our cart just beyond the village ditch! They seized all the ore and are lurking outside our borders, waiting to slay anyone who pursues them!
They picked the wrong quarry to plunder. I will hunt down these dogs and take back our Star Iron in blood.
May the heavens strengthen your arm! They cannot have gone far, so ride out and strike before they escape with our ore!
Do you have any reserve ore kept in your cellars? I will pay 2,000 gold right now to compensate your miners.
Aye, our foreman held five rough ingots in the locked furnace store for emergencies. For two thousand gold, our village can rebuild. Here, take the ore to the smith before more brigands smell it!
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
Master smith, I hold the five chunks of Star Iron you commanded me to fetch.
By the anvil of the ancients! That dark, starlit sheen... It is genuine fallen star-metal! You survived the merchant's cutthroats and claimed what is rightfully yours.
Take the ore, master. Kindle your coals and let us forge our oath in steel.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
Journeyman's Trial

Grim tidings reach your camp: the master smith {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} has caught wind of an arson plot against his workshop, orchestrated by the vengeful merchant {RakipTuccar_Link}. Ride to his forge at once.
You chose to stand vigilant over the workshop for 5 days. Keep your scouts posted and blades sharpened; the saboteurs will strike under cover of darkness.
Rival Workshop Saboteurs
The merchant paid us well to turn that forge to ash! Step aside, or burn with the anvil!
The only thing turning to ash tonight is your band of arsonists. Draw!
Torches pierce the night! The rival saboteurs have assaulted the workshop perimeter. Crush them before the bellows are put to the torch!
Rather than wait for flames to rise, you decided to sever the snake's head. Track down {RakipTuccar_Link} and put an end to this conspiracy.
{RakipTuccar_Link} refused to back down and unleashed his hired bodyguards upon you. Cut them down to assert your clan's will.
The forge stands triumphant! In recognition of your steadfast protection and martial cunning, {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} confers upon you the Journeyman's Seal.
I heard alarming rumors, master. What troubles your forge?

A shadow hangs over the anvil, my friend. {RakipTuccar_Link} has gathered brigands and cutthroats to burn my workshop to the ground. If the hearth turns cold, the great blade shall never be finished. How shall we meet this malice?
I shall post guards and keep watch over your workshop. No arsonist shall breathe within our perimeter.
Defense invites hesitation. I shall hunt down {RakipTuccar_Link} directly and break his will before the torches are lit.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
We must settle the matter of your arsonists and the blacksmith's forge, merchant.
Ah, the clan warlord barks! Commerce in this district belongs to those with coin, not ancient fossil smiths dreaming of bygone kingdoms. What brings you to my ledger?
I offer you 2,000 gold. Call off your arsonists and let this feud end in profit.
Gold always speaks with greater eloquence than pride. Very well, I shall recall my mercenaries. The old fool may hammer in peace.
If you don't recall your cutthroats this instant, your own bedchamber will taste cold steel before sunrise. [Roguery]
B-by the gods, stay back! Lower your blade... I want no quarrel with bloodthirsty sellswords. The contract is canceled, I swear it!
Words are wasted on treacherous vultures like you. Call your mercenaries, and let steel decide who governs this land!
Insolent dog! Guards, seize this meddler and toss their corpse into the gutters!
Merchant Guards
Our master wants your head on a pike! Cut them down!
Your master's gold cannot save you from righteous steel. To arms!
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
Master's Burden
A messenger from {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} rides into your encampment, breathless and distraught. Catastrophe has struck the brotherhood of the anvil. Ride swiftly to the master's side.

The smith's brother and fellow master craftsman, {Kalan_Link}, rots in the foul dungeon of {DusmanKale_Link}. Without his ancient metallurgical secrets, the final folding of the steel is impossible. Infiltrate the dungeons, raise a siege, or ransom him before his spirit breaks.
Horns blare along the battlements of {DusmanKale_Link}! Your escape attempt was discovered and garrison guards flood the corridors. You must fight your way out to deliver Kalan to safety!
Against all odds, you broke the chains of {Kalan_Link}! The twin masters of the anvil are reunited at last, ready to kindle the ritual fires for the ancestral masterpiece.
Your messenger rode his horse near to death, master. What grief has fallen upon you?

My brother, {Kalan_Link}... While traveling the passes with quenching fluxes, he was captured and thrown into the dungeon pit at {DusmanKale_Link}. His hands alone possess the secret temper to bind the blade's edge. Without him, our labor turns to dust. I beg of you, bring him back to the forge!
No cage shall keep a craftsman of our covenant. I will breach {DusmanKale_Link} and return your brother unharmed.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
Quiet, smith. Keep your voice low. I come under oath from your brother to cut your chains.
My brother sent you? Praise the ancestral heavens! But the portcullis is barred and watchmen patrol the courtyard every bell. How can we break through the garrison?
Follow in my footsteps and step only when the torches shift. I have mapped every guard rotation. [Roguery]
Like ghosts through the stone... Lead on, friend, before the relief watch arrives!
There is no slipping past them quietly. Ready your fists or seize a torch; we carve our way to the gate!
Alarms in the keep! The garrison has spotted us! Stand fast!
Garrison Guards
Dungeon breach! The prisoner is escaping! Cut down the intruders!
Master Kalan walks free today! Stand aside or be cut down!
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
Forging the Legacy
The long saga nears its culmination. With {Kalan_Link} restored to the bellows, the master smith {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} bids you hasten to the workshop for the final tempering of the ancestral blade.
To awaken the soul of the folded Star Iron, the masters require the sacred 'Heart's Fire' ritual. Procure 50,000 denars for the rare oils and crucible catalysts, then deliver the sum to the smiths.

The anvils have fallen silent. Steam rises from the tempering trough. The Covenant Sword shines with celestial brilliance! Speak with {EfsaneviDemirci_Link} to determine who shall bear this legendary weapon.
You claimed the Covenant Sword as your clan's sacred heirloom! Its unmatched balance and razor keenness will lead your bloodline to dominion across all Calradia.

You presented the peerless Covenant Sword to your sovereign, King {IttifakKrali_Link}. The gesture shakes the royal court; songs of your unshakeable chivalry and devotion resound throughout the realm.
The bellows roar like dragons today, master. Is the steel ready for the final fold?

Welcome, noble warlord. For weeks my brother {Kalan_Link} and I have folded the celestial steel a thousand times over the anvil. The blade is straight and flawless. But to breathe an eternal soul into the metal, we must ignite the 'Heart's Fire'. This sacred ritual requires rare alchemical fluxes and royal crucible catalysts worth 50,000 gold.
No price is too great for the destiny of my bloodline. I shall gather the 50,000 gold and return.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
Let the crucible be stoked, master. I have returned with our offering.
Do you bring the gold to kindle the Heart's Fire?
Here is the 50,000 gold. Kindle the flame and quench the blade!
I have not yet amassed the full sum. Keep the embers banked; I shall return shortly.
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

The flames leap blue and white! Give us but a few hours... (The rhythmic thunder of twin hammers echoes through the valley as incandescent sparks cascade across the workshop floor) It is finished! Behold the Covenant Blade! Speak to me once more, warrior, for a fateful choice remains.
The blade is breathtaking. What final counsel do you give, master?

The Covenant Sword... The purest, most lethal steel these hands shall ever fashion. A weapon worthy of reshaping empires. Will you bind its glory to your clan's eternal bloodline, or will you offer it as a gift of supreme fealty to your liege lord?
This sword was bought with my clan's blood and sweat. It shall remain our eternal heirloom and the standard beneath which my heirs shall conquer!
I shall present this peerless blade to my sovereign king. In the monarch's hands, it shall elevate our clan to the right hand of the throne!
I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

Welcome, warrior. Hear you the deep breath of the bellows? For generations, this hearth has burned in kinship with your bloodline. I knew your forebears well; these hands shaped the ancient steel that laid your house's seat. Yet centuries have passed, and banners have fallen. It is time you carried a Covenant Sword worthy of your lineage.
You spoke of my ancestors' vow, master. What is this Iron Covenant? Whence comes the bond between your forge and my bloodline?
I care not for ancient tales, but for steel that splits shields in twain. What would you ask of me, smith?

Before the First Empire arose, a blazing star plummeted from the heavens into these hills. The ancient smiths' guild and your ancestors swore a blood covenant to guard its heart. The Covenant Sword is no mere trinket; it is power destined to make its bearer master of the realm. Yet common iron cannot bear such a vow; I require 5 chunks of genuine fallen Star Iron.

Any horse-shoer can hammer out shield-splitting iron, child! The blade I speak of reaps the destiny of kingdoms. You yearn to spill blood, I know, yet without the forge's spirit, the steel you swing is no better than a timber club. Only one ore can birth such a weapon: 5 chunks of genuine fallen Star Iron!
Star Iron... What secret lies within this ore? What makes it so unyielding upon your anvil?
Where lies this ore vein, and who dares stand in our path? Whoever bars my way shall taste my steel.

Star Iron shimmers with a pale celestial sheen in darkness; though it blazes white-hot in the hearth, it remains cold and stubborn beneath the hammer. The only bellows in Calradia capable of yielding it are here. A vein was uncovered in the quarry near {HammadeKaynagi_Link}. But the miners cannot haul it unaided; a covetous merchant, {RakipTuccar_Link}, caught scent of it and encircled the quarry with spies.

The ore lies in the quarry of {HammadeKaynagi_Link}. Yet the true hazard is not the rock, but the hired cutthroats of merchant {RakipTuccar_Link}! That greedy vulture seeks to seize my craft and sell the celestial ore to imperial palaces for a king's ransom. You must confer with the village elder {KoyMuhtari_Link} and secure the ore.
Your hearth shall never turn cold, master. I will ride to the village, confer with the elder, and carry the Star Iron to your anvil myself.
If that merchant's hired dogs dare cross my path, I shall leave their carcasses for the crows. I ride for the village at once.

May the spirits of our forebears guide your stride, child. Ride to {HammadeKaynagi_Link} and find {KoyMuhtari_Link}. Keep your eyes sharp and your blade loose in its scabbard. I shall kindle the coals against your return.
How many were they, and which direction did they flee? Did they spill village blood?
Kept you no reserve ore in the quarry cellars? Is there no emergency cache in the village?

Thirty armored cutthroats at least! They ambushed our wagon in the gully just past the ditch, loaded the ore into their saddlebags, and now lurk in the brush mocking us. If you approach, they will bare their blades!

Our quarry foreman is a cautious man; he locked five raw chunks of Star Iron deep within the furnace cellar for dire emergencies. But that ore is our village's famine reserve; I cannot turn the key without coin to compensate our miners.
Your hearth's fire and our ancestors' oath guided my path, master. The hands worthy of forging this celestial steel are yours alone.
Those who barred my way tasted cold wrath. Enough words; let us hear the anvil ring beneath your hammer!
Kindle the bellows! Your apprentice's oath has been honored in blood and toil, child. Now let the hearth roar, and let the steel take shape!
How many generations has this forge stood, master? How dares a mere merchant scheme to burn so ancient a workshop?
How many saboteurs has he recruited, and from where do they plan to launch their torching?

For three centuries this hearth has tempered the crowns of kings and forged the heirlooms of great houses. Yet when that merchant failed to extort our quenching fluxes and ancient dies, he vowed that what he cannot own shall turn to ash. He believes his coin can purchase impunity.

Rumors say he hired over sixty cutthroats. In the dead of night, when watchmen are heaviest with sleep, they intend to scale the workshop eaves with pitch-soaked torches. If flames take the timbers, saving the bellows will be impossible.
I honor your steadfast resolve, warrior. Post your scouts around the perimeter and keep watch for five nights. If flames rise, our honor burns with them!
Bold words from a true warlord! Track down {RakipTuccar_Link} and force him to tear up that treacherous contract. Yet beware: the guards bought by his gold are seasoned sellswords.
Is burning a centuries-old craft and innocent lives truly worth securing a petty monopoly? Is this what Calradia's laws taught you?
Your coin can purchase you naught but a shallow grave, merchant. If a single spark touches that forge, I shall turn your caravans to ash and your flesh to carrion.
Every breath has its price in your ledger. What is the sum to call off your cutthroats and leave the forge unmolested?

The law? (Laughs harshly) Warlords extort tribute, lords gorge at banquets, and those with gold write the laws! That stubborn old smith refused to bow, so he must burn. Yet if you wish to close my ledger, either open your purse or let your steel speak!
Your tongue is sharp, but the spears of my forty hired mercenaries are sharper! You do not frighten me, warrior. Either compensate my lost profits, or leave your corpse in the gutter!

At last, someone who speaks sense! For the advance coin paid to the arsonists and my foregone weapon margins, I demand 2,000 gold. Hand over the coin and the torches are extinguished; refuse, and steel shall decide!
Why is Master Kalan's craft so indispensable? What is the secret of these quenching salts, master?
How formidable are the ramparts and dungeons of {DusmanKale_Link}? Does his rescue call for open warfare or silent shadows?

We are twin masters of the anvil; I shape the steel and rule the flames, while Kalan listens to the metal's song at the moment of quenching. With celestial fluxes he tempers the blade so it remains keen as a razor yet supple as a willow branch. Without him, this sword is stillborn!

{DusmanKale_Link} is a black monolith perched atop sheer crags. Its garrison is numerous, and torches illuminate the battlements like noon. Yet in the dungeon corridors lie drainage sluices and blind spots during the watch relief. A master of shadows or a fearless rescuer can slip inside.
No craftsman of our covenant shall rot in an enemy pit. I swear upon my clan's honor to bring your brother Kalan back to this hearth unharmed.
The walls of {DusmanKale_Link} cannot bar my fury. If need be, I shall leave not one stone upon another to bring Kalan home!
May the ancestral gods shroud your footsteps in mist, warrior. Show Kalan the seal of the forge; he will know you. Go, and wrench my brother from that subterranean darkness!
Your brother bade me say: 'The sacred fire turns to ash never, and true steel bends never.' He awaits you at the anvil.
Look into my eyes, master; I am no phantom. I have come to tear these dungeon walls down upon their heads. Ready yourself!

The covenant watchword... You are truly my brother's sworn companion! (Tears glisten on his soot-streaked cheeks) The gods be praised! The dungeon key rests on the head jailer's belt, and two torchbearers pace the courtyard.
Your fierce resolve speaks through your voice, warrior! I have loosened my manacles, yet days of starvation weigh upon me. Sentries bar our path; every step must be measured.
What is this 'Heart's Fire' ritual? Why does ordinary coal not suffice for this steel, master?
What is the toll of such a rite, master? My clan's treasury stands ready to bring this legend to fruition.

Because Star Iron fell from the firmament, it scorns earthly heat, child. The Heart's Fire burns with distilled quicksilver, rare brimstone salts, and consecrated oils; its flame blazes radiant azure. When steel is quenched in that crucible, its grains fuse forever, and the blade acquires an unbreakable soul.
Procuring these rare fluxes and royal catalysts demands 50,000 gold. A sum that could equip an entire royal cohort, yet the sword it births will wield the might to bend whole armies to its will.
For the eternal renown of my lineage and my ancestors' covenant, 50,000 gold is a light burden. I shall gather the coin and return to your forge.
No tribute is too steep for a blade that will shake Calradia to its core. I will fetch the gold; prepare the crucible!
May your word prove sturdier than tempered steel, child. Amass the 50,000 gold while we bank the crucibles. When this flame erupts, all Calradia shall bear witness!
My house's sigil gleams upon the pommel. This weapon was kneaded with my clan's blood; can it truly belong to anyone else?
Were I to present this blade to my sovereign... Would it not serve the realm's peace and elevate our house beside the throne?
If you keep it for your bloodline, your heirs shall reap conquests beneath its edge for centuries; your name will echo across royal halls. You will carve your destiny with your own right arm.
If you offer it to your liege lord, your clan will claim the highest seat at the royal council; the monarch's gratitude and your political renown will know no bounds. The choice rests in your heart.
Teach me too the secret of folding this steel, master. Whence springs this ancient bond between your forge and my bloodline?
Such a weapon commands immense weight in both war and trade. What does your guild seek from our clan in exchange?

Your spirit honors your ancestors, child! Before the First Empire arose, a blazing star fell from the firmament into these hills. The ancient guild and your bloodline swore a blood covenant to guard its heart. The Covenant Sword cannot be folded from earthly ores; I require 5 chunks of genuine fallen Star Iron.

Coin buys hirelings, but only sacred steel purchases eternity. Our guild seeks no denars from you, but fidelity to our oath. If our steel sleeps in an unworthy scabbard, our guild's purpose turns to ash. That is why you must bring 5 chunks of Star Iron to this anvil.
Time is dearer than gold, master. If you have an existing prototype ready upon your rack, can I not purchase it here and now?
In your eyes I see the sacred devotion of the ancient apprentices. Go then: speak with elder {KoyMuhtari_Link} in {HammadeKaynagi_Link}, secure the 5 Star Iron chunks, and let our brotherhood begin.

Fierce fire burns in your veins, warlord! But temper your wrath with vigilance. Ride to {HammadeKaynagi_Link}, wrench the 5 Star Iron from the clutches of {RakipTuccar_Link}'s dogs, and bring them back!

You speak with the cold calculation of a merchant, child. Aye, upon my rack rests a prototype forged from an earlier sample. But it is my masterpiece; I will not part with it for less than 10,000 denars. The choice is yours: ride for the ore, or pay the coin.
My oath is sealed, master. I ride for {HammadeKaynagi_Link} to secure the Star Iron.
How long has this quarry been worked, elder? Who else knew of this shipment?

The quarry is ancient, but this celestial vein was uncovered only weeks ago. The merchant's spies bribed one of our mule drivers! Our foreman stashed five ingots in the furnace vault, but the main haul was taken.
Describe their ambush position and defensive lines, elder; I will strike them like a thunderbolt.
They pitched camp among the crags northwest of the ditch. They watch the highway, but approaching through the gully lets you take their flank by surprise.
Our foreman locked five rough ingots deep in the furnace cellar as our village famine reserve. For two thousand denars to feed our miners' families, I will turn the key.
It was a grueling trial, but our covenant held firm, master. The renown this steel brings shall reward us both.
A true apprentice of the covenant! Now watch closely: Star Iron requires celestial flux to bond with the iron core. A single mistimed hammer blow can shatter weeks of labor.
The anvil echoes your war-cry, warrior! Yet know this: raw anger shatters brittle steel. Only when wrath is cooled in disciplined water does the edge become eternal.
Every drop of sweat poured upon this hearth will echo across the realm, warlord. No merchant in Calradia can match what we shape today.
Stoke the flames, master! Let the anvil ring and let the Covenant Sword be born!
How do town magistrates and city guards tolerate such open lawlessness? Can we not call upon the town guard?

The magistrates are fat with that merchant's bribes, child! In Calradia, when coin clinks, justice goes blind. If we wait for courts, our forge will be cold ash before a bailiff even writes a summons.
What defenses can we mount around the perimeter? How are we prepared against torches, master?
Waiting for arsonists invites ruin. Where does this merchant keep his counting house? We must crush the viper in its nest.
We filled the cisterns and barricaded the courtyard. If you and your warriors keep a 5-night vigil, you can drown those brigands in the ditch before they ever light a torch.
He sits in the caravansary of the merchant quarter, flanked by forty hired spearmen. If you march directly upon him, you can tear up that foul contract before a spark is struck.
You boast of hired spears, but sellswords melt away when their master's throat feels cold steel. Do you truly wager your life on hirelings? [Roguery]
Two thousand denars is a fortune for a handful of cutthroats. What guarantee do I have you won't strike again next moon?
(The merchant swallows dryly, stepping back as he eyes your hand on the hilt) The... the underworld whispers of your ruthlessness. Choose quickly then: coin, terror, or blood in the street?
My signature upon parchment is binding across all guilds! Once gold touches my palms, I will burn that arson contract before your very eyes.
Did the captors not demand a ransom, master? Can coin not unlock the dungeon gate without spilling blood?

They demand no ransom because they know not whom they hold! The castellan took him for a vagrant hedge-smith. If they discover his metallurgical secrets, they will bind him in chains to forge blades for enemy banners forever. Ransom is impossible; he must be extracted!
When I reach the dungeon depths, how shall Master Kalan know I come as his savior and not an executioner? What must I say?
If the castle guards sound the horn, I will drown their battlements in fire. What of Master Kalan's physical state?
Whisper our ancient guild vow into his ear: 'The sacred fire turns to ash never, and true steel bends never.' When he hears those words, he will know the breath of the twin hearths.
He is weakened by days of moldy bread and well water, but his will is iron. When he hears the watchword, he will find the strength to run.
Where are the patrol blind spots between the guardroom and the outer passage? [Roguery]
Can you swing a guard's spear if we draw steel and carve our way to the gate, master?
The eastern archway has no torches for thirty paces. When the head jailer reaches for his wine jug, a shadow can lift the latch and slip through.
My arms are cramped, but I can hurl a torch and crack skulls! Yet if the alarm horn sounds, the entire garrison will pour into the corridors.
Generations of our bloodline have waited for this dawn, master. Whatever the furnace demands, our house shall provide.

Your ancestors look down from the halls of eternity with pride, child. Fifty thousand gold is the earthly cost to unlock heavenly power. When azure fire blazes, your house's name will be inscribed upon the stars.
How long does it take to bank the crucibles and stoke the azure flame, master?
Once the blade emerges from the flames, who shall hold the right to dictate its destiny?
Once the gold is delivered, my brother Kalan and I need but a few hours to blend the salts. The coals are already humming.
Yours alone, warlord! It is sealed with your bloodline's covenant. Whether it crowns your heirs or seals your sovereign's realm, the choice rests in your hands.
Does true dominion spring from crowns and thrones, or from the warrior who wields the cold edge?
Thrones crumble and crowns rust away, but legendary steel endures. Whether bound to your banner or gifted to a sovereign, it is the wielder's honor that gives the steel its soul.
And what says your own heart, master? As a craftsman who turned gray before this forge, in whose hands do you wish this masterpiece to shine?
Steel has no king, warrior; it knows only the will of whoever grips its hilt. My hammer has finished its work; the final verse of this legend belongs to you.

Then take it, true Heir of the Covenant! May this celestial steel split shields, shatter armor, and guide your heirs to rule Calradia! (Lifts the gleaming blade and presents it upon the anvil cushion) Wear it with honor, warlord!

A noble and far-sighted decision! A weapon worthy of an emperor's hand... (Carefully sheathes the blade into a velvet scabbard emblazoned with golden sigils and presents it) Present this to King {IttifakKrali_Link}. His gratitude shall echo in songs for a hundred winters!
